notes: Lightweight edition: removes SoundCloud, YouTube, sign-in and the crush-message piggy. Offline bundled music uses one player with saved volume and mute. Preprocessed small avatar images replace large sprite sheets and expensive phone-side masking. Fewer particles, 30fps celebrations and one cheer per win. Poker stays on the table after each hand, with the winner name and celebration only; round history and next-hand controls remain available. Action speech bubbles stay above portraits. Existing rooms and saves are preserved; no room-server deployment.
